data.value: Eawag lake models calculate up to four days ahead how warm it is at 0, 10, 20 and 30 m and where the thermocline lies.

data.name: How_Weather_Text
data.value: Heavy rain makes inflows murky, wind stirs up the shore. Both go into the index.

data.name: How_Community_Text
data.value: Reporting the visibility after a dive improves the forecast. It is not required.

data.name: Footer_Note
data.value: Forecasts are indicators, without guarantee. Never dive alone and stay within your training.
